SELECT s.id AS sku_id, s.spu_id, p.name AS product_name, s.sku_code, s.spec_name, s.spec_values, s.sale_unit, s.product_type, s.market_price, p.category_id, c.name AS category_name FROM product_sku s JOIN product_spu p ON p.id = s.spu_id LEFT JOIN product_category c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE s.deleted = FALSE AND p.deleted = FALSE AND s.status = 'ON_SHELF' AND p.status = 'ON_SHELF'
AND (p.category_id = #{query.categoryId} OR p.category_id IN (SELECT child.id FROM product_category child WHERE child.parent_id = #{query.categoryId} AND child.deleted = FALSE))
AND (p.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR p.spu_code ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR s.sku_code ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
AND (#{query.visibilityPolicy} = 'ALL_ENABLED' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customer_sku_visibility v WHERE v.customer_id = #{query.customerId} AND v.sku_id = s.id AND v.deleted = FALSE)) ORDER BY p.name, s.id

SELECT s.id AS sku_id, s.spu_id, p.name AS product_name, s.sku_code, s.spec_name, s.spec_values, s.sale_unit, s.product_type, s.market_price, p.category_id, c.name AS category_name FROM product_sku s JOIN product_spu p ON p.id = s.spu_id LEFT JOIN product_category c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE s.id = #{skuId} AND s.deleted = FALSE AND p.deleted = FALSE AND s.status = 'ON_SHELF' AND p.status = 'ON_SHELF' AND (#{visibilityPolicy} = 'ALL_ENABLED' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customer_sku_visibility v WHERE v.customer_id = #{customerId} AND v.sku_id = s.id AND v.deleted = FALSE))

SELECT c.id, c.parent_id, c.name, c.level, c.sort_order, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_spu p JOIN product_sku s ON s.spu_id = p.id WHERE p.category_id = c.id AND p.deleted = FALSE AND s.deleted = FALSE AND p.status = 'ON_SHELF' AND s.status = 'ON_SHELF' AND (#{visibilityPolicy} = 'ALL_ENABLED' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customer_sku_visibility v WHERE v.customer_id = #{customerId} AND v.sku_id = s.id AND v.deleted = FALSE))) AS product_count FROM product_category c WHERE c.deleted = FALSE AND c.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY c.level, c.sort_order, c.id
